proposed_from.topic: Probability-weighted Fourier exposure-incidence risk certificates for off-policy causal estimation in networks. Fix a known graph, uniformly positive source and target product-Bernoulli policies, known finite downward-closed local Fourier supports, and bounded fixed schedules observed once under the source law. Define the exact assignment-indexed linear minimax risk F and prove F equals its covariance-moment dual, with minimizing weights, a clipped incidence estimator, computable primal and genuine-prior lower certificates, an instance-adaptive rank/fiber comparison to unrestricted all-Borel minimax risk, and complexity-calibrated consistency. Prove exact all-Borel equality on the one-nonconstant additive-l1 hub family, the broader additive-hub n^{-1} frontier and Loomba–Eckles envelope separation including the local-policy n^{-1/2} elbow, and disjoint-motif recovery under its explicit unbiased-witness premise. Give the exact fully expanded finite program and a width-one obstruction showing ordinary raw-incidence bag moments do not determine the squared target moment. The dimension-free universal comparison, unconditional reverse consistency over all admissible arrays, and exact compressed bounded-treewidth algorithm remain open. Crépon and Chin–Eckles–Ugander are prospective design-audit consumers after design-specific inputs are supplied; no empirical reanalysis is claimed.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest generic result, ChenValiantValiant2020, stops at the optimal semilinear class and explicitly leaves its gap from unrestricted procedures open. The closest causal result, LoombaEckles2026OffPolicy, optimizes an unbiased transport weight one function space at a time and proves only a maximum-overlap sufficient consistency bound. The proposed theorem instead identifies a coupled bounded-schedule minimax functional and claims a dimension-free equivalence to every measurable estimator on a structured selector class, with a genuine probability-prior converse. Its strict empirical content is falsifiable: the additive-hub family must have \(R_n^{\star}\asymp F_n=\Theta(n^{-1})\) while the published degree envelope fails to vanish, and exhaustive small-instance search must stop the universal claim if \(R^{\star}/F\) tends to zero. The treewidth question is not presented as settled or used to inflate the statistical claim.

seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 1, Fact 1, Appendix D, and the open question in Section 4; read together with LoombaEckles2026OffPolicy, Proposition on spectral transport and Section 8.
seed_details.opportunity: Prove a dimension-free constant comparison between the finite semilinear risk and unrestricted minimax risk on the product-Bernoulli local-Fourier selector class.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first unresolved step is converting an optimizer of the second-moment body into a genuine bounded-schedule prior whose nonlinear posterior variance preserves linear residual risk.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Replace Donoho's hardest Gaussian rectangle and Chen's semidefinite rounding by common-fiber ambiguity rounding for noiseless selector observations.
seed_details.destination_search: Searched product-Bernoulli selector semilinear unrestricted minimax, randomly collected data nonlinear gap, and design-based network minimax; no closer result subsumes the structured comparison.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from DonohoLiuMacGibbon1990 because the bounded schedule class is centrally symmetric and convex.
seed_details.rebuttal: The Gaussian comparison requires quadratic convexity and noisy additive observations; ChenValiantValiant2020 already shows strict semilinear failure for noiseless random selectors, so a new fiber-preserving argument is required.

seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem on consistency under spectral overlap and its proof, which counts intersecting influence sets and applies Cauchy--Schwarz uniformly.
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize consistency by \(F_n\to0\) if and only if unrestricted minimax MSE vanishes, and exhibit an additive-hub family with \(F_n=\Theta(n^{-1})\) while the published envelope does not vanish.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step is an all-estimator lower bound retaining shared-selector fibers instead of covariance counting or disjoint complete blocks.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Ignore the single high-degree hub for the upper bound and use peripheral one-bit ambiguity for the lower bound; use the universal comparison to close the general iff direction.
seed_details.destination_search: Searched Fourier overlap necessity, Riesz necessary sufficient consistency, hub network minimax, and conflict-graph heterogeneous degree results; only estimator-class or design-optimized frontiers were located.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from LoombaEckles2026OffPolicy because its variance bound already implies consistency.
seed_details.rebuttal: That result is sufficient for one unbiased estimator; it supplies neither necessity against all procedures nor a family where exact signed probability geometry changes the rate.

proposed_from.literature_map: The selected kernel is anchored at ChenValiantValiant2020, Theorem 1, Fact 1, Appendix D, and Section 4: semilinear risk is algorithmically approximated, strict nonlinear improvement is exhibited, and universal comparability is posed as an open question. LoombaEckles2026OffPolicy, Proposition on spectral transport, the spectral-overlap consistency theorem, its covariance-counting proof, and Section 8 provide the causal setup, writing arc, and exact estimator-side gap. BrownCohen2021, Section 3, proves a constant all-estimator lower bound under alpha-non-expansion but does not cover vanishing-risk structured selectors. DonohoLiuMacGibbon1990 proves a \(1.25\) linear comparison for Gaussian quadratically convex classes and supplies the hardest-subproblem method exemplar, while also warning that nonlinear gains can be unbounded outside that geometry. KandirosHarshawSavje2026Minimax reduces unrestricted design-based network risk to an estimand-specific conflict graph, but its target and choice of design differ from fixed-policy Fourier transport. HarshawSavjeWang2022, Section 5, gives an iff operator-norm condition only for the Riesz estimator. CortezRodriguezEichhornYu2023 supplies the low-order Bernoulli score and fuzzy-prior lower-bound donor. WainwrightJordan2004 and PeyrardEtAl2019 delimit what a valid treewidth theorem would require. ChinEcklesUgander2022, Kallus2018OptimalBalance, and CreponEtAl2013 establish concrete design and application consumers. No closer paper was found that proves the product-Bernoulli local-Fourier semilinear-to-unrestricted comparison or raw-incidence optimizer locality.

banked_reason: Unrestricted all-Borel risk remains separated from F by rank or fiber factors that may grow exponentially; no non-identical bounded same-topic repair reaches the field floor.
